title: The Price of Isolation: Estimating the Ecosystem Cost of Symmetric Two-Sided A/B Testing
abstract: arXiv:2608.04432v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On two-sided content platforms, symmetric two-sided isolation (assigning matched fractions of creators and viewers to isolated treatment and control submarkets) is widely used for creator-side and cold-start experiments because it removes cross-arm marketplace interference. Isolation, however, thins each viewer's candidate catalog, and intuition suggests the resulting engagement cost should fade as the platform grows: a small fraction of a vast catalog is still vast. We show that, in an order-statistics model of engagement, whether this intuition holds depends on the upper tail of match quality. Extreme-value theory yields tail-class loss laws with a sharp dichotomy: for light or bounded tails the loss vanishes as the candidate pool grows, whereas under heavy tails it converges to a size-independent constant, so expanding the candidate pool, even by orders of magnitude, does not asymptotically eliminate the cost. translated_title: 隔离的代价：评估对称双边A/B测试的生态系统成本
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.04432v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在双边内容平台上，对称双边隔离（将创作者和观众的匹配比例分配到隔离的处理组和对照组子市场）被广泛用于创作者侧和冷启动实验，因为它消除了跨臂市场干扰。然而，隔离会稀释每个观众的候选目录，直觉上认为由此产生的参与成本应随着平台增长而消失：巨大目录的一小部分仍然巨大。我们证明，在参与度的顺序统计模型中，这一直觉是否成立取决于匹配质量的上尾分布。极值理论得出具有尖锐二分法的尾部类别损失定律：对于轻尾或有界尾，损失随候选池增长而消失，而在重尾下，它收敛到一个与规模无关的常数，因此即使将候选池扩大几个数量级，也无法渐近消除该成本。来自两个生产环境的证据支持了这一点。
tldr: 本文通过极值理论证明，在双边平台对称隔离实验中，匹配质量的重尾分布会导致参与成本不随平台规模扩大而消失，揭示了隔离策略的隐藏生态系统代价。
en_tdlr: This paper uses extreme-value theory to show that heavy-tailed match quality makes the engagement cost of symmetric two-sided isolation persist regardless of platform scale, revealing a hidden ecosystem cost of the strategy.
